question: Is appreciable DLK1 gene-level RNA reproducibly present in EMC tissue, and is its pattern consistent enough across assays and authentic models to motivate a specific direct isoform/protein-localization experiment?
prior_art_gate: Searches found no explicit EMC DLK1 primary finding. Subramanian2005 full SAM list lacks searched DLK1 identifiers; this is not a negative measurement. Original reports already establish a neural/neuroendocrine expression phenotype in EMC, so that broad phenotype is not new. Filion supplementary tables and Sjogren source completeness remain visible coverage gaps; independence reviewer is searching broader DLK1 cohorts. Proceed with a bounded empirical pilot, not manuscript advancement.

primary.operational_abundance_gate: At least 8/12 primary specimens >=10 TPM AND median >=10 TPM. These are prospective resource-allocation thresholds, not validated biological or target thresholds. A failed gate does not prove no expression.
primary.independence: 12 specimen labels; patient_group equals sample_id in metadata, not a definitive external donor crosswalk. Do not pool across studies or count historical subset as independent.

sensitivities.purpose: Retain all eligible EMC measurements; historical 9 is a sensitivity, not a new independent cohort. Recurrent specimen 5081-14 shown separately.

metrics: 2000 resample specimen bootstrap percentile95% intervals for primary median and A, seed41026
same-sequencing-year A where both groups exist
comparisons.inference: No confirmatory p-value threshold; one biologically chosen gene, several exploratory contrasts. Enrichment and disease exclusivity are not required for an appreciable RNA phenotype. Bootstrap reflects sampled specimens and cannot repair batch/confounding/overlap.

cross_assay.GSE24369: All6 EMC, all available LGFMS17/MFS6/desmoid6/SFT5 and2 skeletal-muscle pools. Original RMA log2 signal. Map all unambiguous DLK1/Entrez8788 probes from GPL6244, retain each; median probes only as transparent summary. Direction/heterogeneity descriptive, donor overlap with Hofvander unresolved; no independent replication claim.
cross_assay.GSE4303: All10 labelled EMC; audit every platform, probe and channel/reference before contrast. Do not compare different reference pools as common-scale ratios. All suitable accessible EMC values must be evaluated before any claim advancement.
cross_assay.PeerJ12: All12 published filtered matrix; absence of DLK1 row is filtered absence, not zero. Raw TempOSeq gene measurement remains pending if absent.
cross_assay.GSE71119: Verify source and every eligible EMC condition; metadata-only source pointer not treated as evaluation.

models.V1-34_GSM2113301: One biological library, two technical SRA runs; archived ARCHS4 rounded estimated counts and CPM using all-row denominator.
models.USZ22_GSM6883080: One authentic TAF15::NR4A3 culture; ARCHS4 CPM descriptive, not TPM.
models.USZ23_GSM9037837: One original RefSeq Salmon quantification; DLK1 transcript mapping must be source-verified; sum mapped TPM, retain all mapped rows. Unknown donor independence from USZ20.
models.unavailable_authentic: USZ20 and NCC-EMC1-C1 public expression not yet recovered; source-verified unavailability must remain visible.
models.uncertain_identity: HEMC-SS is separate context, never proof of EMC expression or absence.
models.interpretation: No formal across-model replicate test. Culture expression may support tumor-intrinsic plausibility but does not locate expression in original tissue. Culture absence prompts source/condition checks; cannot be explained away.

defeaters: Same useful DLK1 EMC finding already published
Weak or heterogeneous tissue abundance fails operational allocation; do not change threshold
Probe/reference ambiguity prevents claimed cross-assay result
Material contrary authentic tissue/model evidence unexplained
Composition dependence or normal-tissue signal prevents claimed tumor localization
No worthwhile new biological interpretation beyond an RNA nomination
automatic_followup: Audit adverse/probe/identity/condition evidence, source-linked published measurements, all eligible EMC and independent challenge. A technical pass is insufficient; explicitly reassess scientific value. Do not replace DLK1 with another gene. No manuscript while suitable accessible EMC remains pending.
limits: RNA does not establish cell-surface or membrane isoform, protein abundance, dependency, therapeutic window or response.
Expression in other cancers alone does not defeat EMC phenotype value.
Known RMS/MPNST/normal progenitor expression and sarcoma RNA-protein discordance are material alternatives.
